context: Request: all Banking & Finance deals that negotiated defined adjusted-EBITDA add-backs, with a document showing the add-backs for each. Rubric: nine matters (1005-00001 Nexford, 1006-00001 Crestline, 1010-00001 Arbor, 1012-00001 Stonefield, 1019-00002 Whitmore, 1021-00001 Verimark, 1038-00002 Cascade Retail, 1042-00001 Brightfield, 1043-00001 Ironhaven), a proof document per matter, plus a precision criterion.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Shell find on the store (empty), a pwd/ls of the workspace, then find | head -200 over all files.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Files-with-matches grep with a `*` glob; returns nothing.

stages.stage: List matter folders
stages.note: Lists matter folders and their subfolders, first 240 lines.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: find | grep over file paths for credit, loan and agreement words, first 240 hits.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads an issues list, a covenant memo and four credit agreements from five matters on that list.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: A store-wide python-docx scan times out; a path search for an engagement number seen in a document; then a zipfile scan for files with EBITDA plus add-back or negotiation words lists hits in many matters (about 124K chars). Labelled by the dominant intent.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads negotiation memos and draft agreements from eight matters picked from the scan list.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: Narrower scan grouping add-back and negotiation hits by matter.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads memos and agreements from five matters, including a sibling matter of a client already read.

stages.stage: Read a chosen matter's documents in depth
stages.note: Reads a later section of one negotiation memo and a restructuring term sheet.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet scripts pulling EBITDA and add-back passages from the term sheet and three named documents.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads the openings of two more credit agreements.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet scripts pulling the EBITDA definitions from five named agreements.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes nine matters, each with a document showing its add-backs.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → List matter folders → Search file names for request keywords → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Read a chosen matter's documents in depth → Search within a candidate matter's files → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: A scan listed every qualifying matter, but two were never opened, two that were read were left out, and the answer added drafts and a sibling matter.

first_error.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
first_error.why: The scan just before listed all nine qualifying matters, but the eight matters it chose to read left two of them out, and it never opened those two later.

other_errors.why: Two qualifying matters whose negotiation memos it had read are left out of the answer without a stated reason.
Counted draft and term-sheet matters, and cited a client's sibling matter in place of the matter whose executed agreement it had read.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Read documents picked from the file listing
stages.note: Two batches: engagement letters, then transaction documents and memos, of the matters at the top of the listing.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: An unzip | grep loop over all documents prints nothing; a python-docx scan for EBITDA and credit-agreement lines times out after about 1.7M chars.

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads engagement letters and a credit agreement of three matters from the scan output.

stages.stage: Search within a candidate matter's files
stages.note: Snippet script pulling the Adjusted EBITDA definition from two named agreements.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes two matters, each with its executed agreement.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Read documents picked from the file listing → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Search within a candidate matter's files → Write the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: The only working scan timed out early; the answer names the two matters it reached and omits the other seven.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its scans either printed nothing or timed out after reaching only two of the matters it needed; it accepted the partial output and did not narrow the scan or search another way.

stages.stage: List files in the document store
stages.note: Shell find (empty) plus whole-store glob.

stages.stage: Search file contents for request keywords
stages.note: Files-with-matches grep for EBITDA, add-back and financing words with a `**/*` glob.

stages.stage: Search file names for request keywords
stages.note: Python walk listing files under folders whose names contain financing words.

stages.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
stages.note: A store-wide python-docx scan times out after about 160K chars; a second scan limited to financing and transaction folders lists EBITDA-definition and add-back lines (about 150K chars).

stages.stage: Screen candidate matters by reading documents
stages.note: Reads 20-35-line openings of memos and agreements from five matters; a second batch of five guessed new-matter-memo paths all fail.

stages.stage: Write the response
stages.note: Writes thirteen matters from the scan snippets and openings.

stages.stage: Check or revise the response
stages.note: Adds five more matters, re-reads the top of the response and updates the count to eighteen.

stages.stage: Finish the run
stages.note: Calls finish.

runs.sequence: List files in the document store → Search file contents for request keywords → Search file names for request keywords → Scan document text with an extraction script → Screen candidate matters by reading documents → Write the response → Check or revise the response → Finish the run
runs.failure_point: Partial scans reached six qualifying matters; the answer lists eighteen from snippets and skims, adding many outside the set and missing three.

first_error.stage: Scan document text with an extraction script
first_error.why: Its scans (one timed out, the other limited to finance-named folders) reached six of the nine matters it needed; it searched no further, so the other three never entered its candidate set.

other_errors.why: Counted every matter whose scan snippet showed an EBITDA definition or add-back, after 20-35-line skims, including drafts and a sibling matter of one client.

divergence: All three runs failed, in two ways. T0 ran a scan that listed every qualifying matter, but the matters it chose to read left two out (surfaced, never opened); it also dropped two matters it had read and added drafts and a sibling matter. T1 and T2 relied on scans that timed out or were narrowed to finance-named folders and reached only some qualifying matters (search miss); T1 wrote the two it reached, T2 wrote eighteen matters from snippets and short skims (over-inclusion).
